mapper.update: UPDATE `document` SET parent_id = #{parentId}, title = #{title}, file_name = #{fileName}, status = #{status}, storage_type = #{storageType}, bucket_name = #{bucketName}, storage_path = #{storagePath}, content_type = #{contentType}, content_size = #{contentSize}, content_hash = #{contentHash}, idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, document_code, workspace_id, parent_id, owner_user_id, title, file_name, document_type, status, storage_type, bucket_name, storage_path, content_type, content_size, content_hash, idempotency_key, created_at, updated_at FROM `document` WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, document_code, workspace_id, parent_id, owner_user_id, title, file_name, document_type, status, storage_type, bucket_name, storage_path, content_type, content_size, content_hash, idempotency_key, created_at, updated_at FROM `document` WHERE document_code = #{documentCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, document_code, workspace_id, parent_id, owner_user_id, title, file_name, document_type, status, storage_type, bucket_name, storage_path, content_type, content_size, content_hash, idempotency_key, created_at, updated_at FROM `document` WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC
